title: Cure temperature and bond strength
intro: An adhesive maker cured ten lap joints at oven temperatures from 60 to 105 °C and tested their shear strength (MPa). x is the cure temperature, y the strength. Read the slope with its test and 95 % confidence interval, and the two intervals at 88 °C: one for the mean strength of all joints cured at 88 °C, one for a single new joint.
